input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: verified-dse milestone 125: register SWG(32) and test it blind on new families at 28 to 36 gates, plus 64-bit multi-lane shifters for width scaling

errors.what: a modular-add amount family gave 37 gates for every modulus tried, outside the 28-36 window

doc_friction.issue: Reproduce section says only milestones 108 to 113 use Yosys 0.70 / OpenROAD 26Q3; every milestone since (through 125) does too, so a reader has to infer the toolchain from LOG entries.

says EDA projects need `apt-get install yosys`, but verified-dse needs Yosys 0.70 from nixpkgs (apt gives an older version that would change gate depths); the nix build line lives only in the project README.

notes: Pre-registration commit b9dfeac0b (designs, guards, eight predictions, features) pushed before the flow. Flow: 1,920 runs, about 60 min on 4 cores, 272 ABC failures (the same 17 sequences per cell). Result: 4 of 8 predictions held; SWG(32) blind 6.79% vs SWC 3.56% vs random 5.69%; gate depth refuted as the separating variable (pmul3 28 gates wins, pmul4 36 loses). Local checks: tests/test_amount_lanes.py and test_amount_place.py 10 passed; research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links ok; check_md_links ok; post front matter, links and similarity ok; paper/build.sh regenerated main.tex.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an EDA researcher designing, verifying and pre-registering eight parametrised shifters, running and analysing a 1,920-point flow, and writing up the result

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
